Description

Beachfront Home with Dual Living and Investment Income Potential

 **DUAL MANDATE** 

Beachfront Home with Dual Living and Investment Income Potential
You'll absolutely love this well-built Cola Beach home - it's the perfect blend of family living and smart investment opportunity. Sitting just 500 metres from the local swim beach, this 483 sqm residence on a generous 773 sqm erf offers practical design with excellent income potential. The main house features three spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms, whilst a separate two-bedroom apartment above the garage provides reliable rental income. It's a brilliant setup for those wanting to offset their mortgage or generate steady cash flow.     

The heart of the home is the north-facing open-plan living area with double-volume ceilings that flood the space with natural light. It flows seamlessly onto a covered patio/ verandah with a built-in braai - perfect for lazy weekend entertaining and coastal gatherings. The main bedroom boasts a full ensuite, whilst the other two bedrooms share a guest bathroom with a separate guest toilet. There's also a dedicated study for home office work, plus a braai room and laundry facilities for added convenience.    

What really sets this property apart is the smart energy setup: five solar panels, dual 2.8 kVA batteries, and an inverter system keep your power bills minimal. The property includes a comprehensive irrigation system with water tanks. There are American shutters throughout that adds both style and security. 

Key Features
483 sqm home on 773 sqm erf, just 500 metres from the beach
Three bedrooms, two bathrooms, plus two-bedroom rental apartment
North-facing open-plan living with covered patio and built-in braai
Solar panels, battery inverter backup, and water tanks for sustainability
Braai room, and two extra parking spaces with a beautiful verandah/ patio   


This coastal gem combines family comfort with genuine investment returns. Ready to explore your new beachfront lifestyle? Get in touch today to arrange your viewing.
